author: Traditionally John Mark, a companion of Peter
authorNote: The Gospels do not name their authors; the names come from early church tradition, which scholars weigh differently.
overview: Mark is the shortest and fastest-moving Gospel. It shows Jesus as the powerful Son of God who heals, teaches and drives out evil, yet goes the way of suffering. Half the book leads up to his death and resurrection in Jerusalem.
storyPlace: Many scholars think Mark was the first Gospel written. A good place to begin reading.
